Title: Change of Target and Disguised or Concealed Weapon

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
A minion attempts to equip with a weapon and is blocked. The minion
plays Change of Target to cancel the action and untap. The same minion
then bleeds and is blocked. Can said minion then Disguise or Conceal
out the same weapon?

I'd assume "Yes" since the minion isn't actually taking an action, but
I couldn't find confirmation so I figured I'd ask. Thanks.

If you werw blocked when trying to equip with the weapon, the weapon's
card went to the ash heap. So, to conceal the same weapon you will
have to have another card of the same weapon in your hand.
